name: Genetically engineered subtly flavored bread yeasts

mentions.name: Genetically engineered subtly flavored bread yeasts
mentions.description: This bioengineering hobby project genetically modifies baker's yeast to produce subtly flavored breads, with a grape-aroma strain already completed and a wintergreen strain in progress, creating niche invite-only genetically engineered flavors the maker can bring to parties around SF as a calling card.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m genetically engineering yeasts to make subtly flavored breads. I’ve already done grape aroma, now working on wintergreen.
